text:
Ibrahim: hey all, first day on-call and running into a couple of small but blocking issues. 1) my PD shifts show up in UTC but my profile timezone is PT — will that auto-convert or do i need to set something? 2) i can't enable mobile push because the MFA prompt never shows up after SSO login. filed access ticket but wanted a faster sanity check.
Zoe: welcome Ibrahim! PD should render local times based on your PD account timezone, but the schedule still lists shifts in the schedule owner's timezone until you view the schedule with "Your shifts". check Settings -> Account -> Timezone in PD.
Kai: on the MFA stuff: if SSO doesn't trigger the MFA dialog it's usually the SSO cookie scope. try `https://sso.redwood.ai/logout` then log back in. also confirm your device is enrolled in the org's MFA provider (Duo). if you're missing Duo, ping infra and they'll resend enrollment.
Ibrahim: did the logout + re-login, still no MFA prompt. PD account page shows "MFA: not configured". ticket says "awaiting admin enrollment".
infra-bot: Identity Service  Manual MFA enrollment request created for ibrahim@redwood.ai. Admin approval required.
Zoe: ok i'll approve the enrollment now. @Kai can you also check that ibrahim is in the oncall SSO group so PD role mapping grants "Responder"? sometimes role mapping blocks ack buttons.
Kai: checked group membership, Ibrahim was missing from "eng-oncall-rotations" due to a sync error earlier. pushed a sync and added a manual PD role mapping: Responder. should land in ~60s.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty  Ibrahim added to schedule "eng-oncall". Please confirm when you see your upcoming shifts.
Ibrahim: i see the schedule now and timezone shows PT correctly, thanks. MFA enrollment approved and i got the Duo setup prompt after re-login. mobile push now working on test alert.
Zoe: great. want to run a 20m sim before you go live? we'll simulate a sev3 throttling alert and walk through ack, notes, and escalation.
Ibrahim: yes please, 20m works. appreciate the quick help and warm welcome :thumbsup:
